principles: Oteryn-Game remains gameplay/world authority and owns the export contract/public allowlist boundary.
Oteryn-Atlas owns derived ingestion, transformation, indexing, rendering and presentation after selective extraction.
Do not wholesale move tools/otbm_atlas/** because accepted architecture records mixed responsibilities.
Do not migrate build/** generated output as source.
Do not mutate Synology, production deployment, DNS, secrets or live state as part of documentation-only extraction planning.
Preserve provenance-pinned reference inputs without promoting them to native gameplay authority.
